title: Equitas SFB says CEO transition will not alter universal banking license strategy
summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank appointed an interim MD and CEO despite PN Vasudevan being available after his resignation, citing governance practices and stakeholder interests. The bank expects to appoint a full-time successor within four months and is evaluating both internal and external candidates, while maintaining that its five year business plan remains unchanged.

direction_reasons: MANAGEMENT_CHANGE cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
watch_next: Equitas Small Finance Bank's follow-up announcements
TMB.why_it_matters: This reaches the company indirectly via its competitor exposure to Equitas Small Finance Bank. The parts of the business most likely touched are management, competition. Classified as management change.
